records.name: Flue
records.one_liner: Function-and-hook authoring over Pi, adding a durable conversation log and Node/Cloudflare deployment runtime.

features_notes.mcp_client: Remote HTTP MCP; no stdio MCP client.
features_notes.os_sandbox: Cloudflare/remote adapter isolation; local() runs on host and just-bash is an emulator.
features_notes.web_ui: React integration and demo, no finished product UI.
features_notes.durable_resume: Requires persistent adapter; start() defaults to memory. step.do does not guarantee external effects exactly once.

dims.loop: Instantiates Pi Agent with parallel tools; rerenders agent function at turn boundaries.
dims.providers: pi-ai provider layer plus Workers AI/AI Gateway integration.
dims.tools: Hook-defined tools, sandbox tools, remote MCP and durable step.do tools.
dims.context: AGENTS.md/skills discovery, per-turn resource narration and compaction.
dims.state: Canonical log and submission ledger; ordinary interrupted tools get unknown outcomes, opt-in durable steps replay recorded results.
dims.safety: No approval engine; local is unsandboxed and isolation comes from selected adapters.
dims.extensibility: Authoring hooks, interceptors, adapters and blueprints; no runtime plugin marketplace.
dims.multi_agent: Declared task delegates share sandbox, durable child conversations and bounded nesting.
dims.surfaces: In-process runtime, HTTP/SDK/React clients, CLI and Node/Cloudflare targets.

key_insights: Function-and-hook authoring over Pi, adding a durable conversation log and Node/Cloudflare deployment runtime.
Canonical log and submission ledger; ordinary interrupted tools get unknown outcomes, opt-in durable steps replay recorded results.
No approval engine; local is unsandboxed and isolation comes from selected adapters.

checked_claims: Session constructs Pi Agent with parallel tools and rerender hook
Ordinary interrupted tool repair is non-reexecuting
Durable tool recovery uses step.do memo records
step.do reads prior record before invoking body
Effect runs before record append, leaving a duplication crash window
corrections: Added explicit effect-before-record crash window and idempotency requirement
unresolved: Node multi-replica ownership requires routing; this review did not stress-test fencing.
verification.scope: Static inspection of selected high-impact claims. Not an exhaustive claim audit; no cloned code executed. Manifest/loop/recovery/safety boundaries prioritized.
